data.cultural_impact: The name "Zafrul" is of Arabic origin and is derived from the root words "zafara" which means gold and "al" which means the one who brings. In Islamic culture, gold and jewels represent wealth and prosperity, and for this reason, the name Zafrul is often given to children as a symbol of hope for a prosperous and abundant future.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, gold and jewels are not only physical symbols of wealth but also representations of spiritual treasure. The Quran states, "The Gardens of Paradise are for them in the presence of their Lord," and gold and jewels are said to be among the rewards given to those who enter Paradise. The spiritual significance of the name Zafrul lies in the hope that the individual named after this beautiful name will be guided towards hoarding spiritual riches rather than material wealth and that they will strive to pursue the eternal treasures promised in the hereafter.

He was also the father of Umar ibn Zafrul, who became the governor of Kufa during the caliphate of Umar ibn Abdulaziz.
